Name: SMAPI Silent Launcher
Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][size=6][b]SMAPI Silent Launcher[/b][/size]
[color=#aaaaaa]No more console window. Just the game.[/color][/center]
[line]
[quote]This hasn't been tested extensively with large modpacks. If you run into issues, please post them on the Bugs tab.[/quote][line]
Tired of the console window sitting open every time you launch Stardew Valley with SMAPI? This replaces it with a small overlay that fades in while the game loads, then disappears. Nothing else changes.
[line]
[size=4][b][color=#e8a87c]Features[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]No console window on launch[/*]
[*]Small status overlay that shows how many mods were loaded, fades out automatically[/*]
[*]Steam achievements, overlay, and playtime tracking all work fine[/*]
[*]No dependencies, no installs, single exe[/*]
[*]Does not modify SMAPI, the game, or any mods[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b][color=#e8a87c]Installation[/color][/b][/size]
Drop [b]SMAPI SilentLauncher.exe[/b] into your Stardew Valley folder, the same folder as [b]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b].
[b]Steam[/b]
Go to Stardew Valley in your Steam library, right-click [b]Properties > General > Launch Options[/b] and set:
[code]"<GameDirectory>\SMAPI SilentLauncher.exe" %command%[/code]Example:
[code]"D:\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\SMAPI SilentLauncher.exe" %command%[/code]Launching this way counts identically to launching SMAPI directly, so Steam achievements, overlay, and playtime all stay active.
[b]GOG[/b]
Point GOG Galaxy at [b]SMAPI SilentLauncher.exe[/b] instead of [b]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/b].
[b]Shortcut / other launcher[/b]
Just point it at [b]SMAPI SilentLauncher.exe[/b] and pass any arguments you normally would. They get forwarded to SMAPI as-is.
[line]
[size=4][b][color=#e8a87c]Antivirus Warnings[/color][/b][/size]
Windows SmartScreen may warn you on first run since the exe is not code-signed. Hit [b]More info > Run anyway[/b].
Some antivirus tools may also flag it. The launcher hides the console window using a technique that overlaps with how some malware behaves, even though nothing malicious is going on here. The full source is on [url=https://github.com/yousv/SMAPI-SilentLauncher]GitHub[/url] if you want to read it or build it yourself.
[line]
[size=4][b][color=#e8a87c]Errors[/color][/b][/size]
[b]"Wrong folder"[/b] - Move [b]SMAPI SilentLauncher.exe[/b] next to [b]Stardew Valley.exe[/b]
[b]"SMAPI is not installed"[/b] - Install SMAPI from [url=https://smapi.io]smapi.io[/url]
[b]"Already running"[/b] - Close the game or SMAPI first
[b]Console appeared anyway[/b] - Launcher timed out, check SMAPI output for what went wrong
[line]
If you run into anything else, please post it on the Bugs tab so it can get looked at.
